Character.Name: Cinder
Character.Description: Cinder is the Field lead of the Cinder Circuit, working the switching rooms and scavenged relay towers. sets the crew plan and gives every member a clear way out. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: graphite mechanic suits with copper panels and live-cyan glass.
Character.Title: Field lead

Character.Name: Arc
Character.Description: Arc is the Quartermaster of the Cinder Circuit, working the switching rooms and scavenged relay towers. keeps the crew supplied and knows which kit can be repaired in the field. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: graphite mechanic suits with copper panels and live-cyan glass.
Character.Title: Quartermaster

Character.Name: Splice
Character.Description: Splice is the Pathfinder of the Cinder Circuit, working the switching rooms and scavenged relay towers. reads routes, sightlines, and exits before the rest of the crew arrives. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: graphite mechanic suits with copper panels and live-cyan glass.
Character.Title: Pathfinder

Character.Name: Fanout
Character.Description: Fanout is the Riflehand of the Cinder Circuit, working the switching rooms and scavenged relay towers. holds a steady lane and calls out changing enemy positions. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: graphite mechanic suits with copper panels and live-cyan glass.
Character.Title: Riflehand

Character.Name: Patchbay
Character.Description: Patchbay is the Bulwark of the Cinder Circuit, working the switching rooms and scavenged relay towers. takes the exposed approach so lighter crew members can reposition. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: graphite mechanic suits with copper panels and live-cyan glass.
Character.Title: Bulwark

Character.Name: Relay
Character.Description: Relay is the Mechanic of the Cinder Circuit, working the switching rooms and scavenged relay towers. keeps radios, doors, lifts, and improvised tools working under pressure. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: graphite mechanic suits with copper panels and live-cyan glass.
Character.Title: Mechanic

Character.Name: Capacitor
Character.Description: Capacitor is the Medic of the Cinder Circuit, working the switching rooms and scavenged relay towers. stabilizes injured crew and refuses to leave anyone behind. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: graphite mechanic suits with copper panels and live-cyan glass.
Character.Title: Medic

Character.Name: Loopback
Character.Description: Loopback is the Marksman of the Cinder Circuit, working the switching rooms and scavenged relay towers. spots threats early and shares a clean shot with the rest of the team. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: graphite mechanic suits with copper panels and live-cyan glass.
Character.Title: Marksman

Character.Name: Jumper
Character.Description: Jumper is the Runner of the Cinder Circuit, working the switching rooms and scavenged relay towers. moves messages and supplies through gaps the larger crew cannot use. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: graphite mechanic suits with copper panels and live-cyan glass.
Character.Title: Runner

Character.Name: Ground
Character.Description: Ground is the Trainee of the Cinder Circuit, working the switching rooms and scavenged relay towers. is the newest member, learning the route from people who trust them. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: graphite mechanic suits with copper panels and live-cyan glass.
Character.Title: Trainee

Chatter.Description: Custom event chatter for Cinder. technician banter, quick diagnostics, and clear electrical hazards; Cinder keeps a line open to Zayden.
Spawned: Cinder, Field lead, reporting from the switching rooms and scavenged relay towers.
WakeUp: Eyes up. Cinder Circuit still has work to finish.
Attacking: Cinder taking the field lead lane. nothing is dead until the wire is cut.
Chasing: Keep my signal. I'm pushing them toward the the switching rooms and scavenged relay towers.
Waiting: Holding position. Check your route before you move.
FriendDied: We lost one of ours. Mark the spot; the rest of us keep moving.
EnemyDown: Cinder confirms one hostile down. Watch the next angle.
Wounded: Cinder is hit! Still moving; get me behind cover!
Died: Tell the crew I made it this far with them.
Chatter.Name: Cinder - Cinder Circuit combat chatter
